findings.question: Q1 NOVELTY
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md §2 sentence: "no SUE, no PEAD, no announcement-date observable has ever been measured on any asset"; refuting rows: research/wayfinder/HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md lines 134 (FXFV5 pre-release windows on evidenced CPI calendars), 136 (FXFV6 release-direction drift), 139 (FXFV7 cross-economy release-sign spillover), 198 (CRYPTO-NG1 FOMC-instant reaction panel), FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl lines 59 (V17 funding-announcement jump), 89 (CNG2 NFP-instant), MAP.md line 122 (FOREX-NG4 Friday day-of-week geometry rho 0.89)
findings.recommendation: The announcement-date observable class HAS been measured on crypto/forex/commodities; only the EARNINGS (actual-EPS/SUE/PEAD) family is unmeasured. Narrow the §2 claim to "no earnings event family (SUE/PEAD/actual-EPS) has ever been measured on any asset". The materially-new-information-set reopening condition (recorded at V8 next_owner_path and V12 close) survives untouched — earnings actuals are a genuinely new information source for the stocks plane — but the sentence as written is refutable from the ledger an auditor must trust.

findings.question: Q2 LEGALITY (authority chain)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md §0 header cites "the owner's standing directive to open the highest-value surviving cycle"; repo grep finds this phrase nowhere except the plan itself; the operative recorded law is research/wayfinder/LESSONS.md P-19 (owner verbatim 2026-09-11: generation ending <= 6 scored cells / 2 families => record lessons/ledger and open ONE more full cycle from scratch, GO standing-delegated) plus the STOCKS-NG2 close at 0/6 (plans/CYCLE_REGISTRY.events.jsonl line 208, ledger line 212); handbook §2.5 "Owner words are literal authority"; P-19 consequence: "Cycle throughput is an owner-set dial, not a Lead inference"
findings.recommendation: Substantive throughput authority EXISTS (P-19 fires on STOCKS-NG2's 0/6 close; the ng1-ng4 registrations all cite the same standing directive in their CYCLE_REGISTERED reasons), so this does not block registration. But §0 should cite P-19 + the STOCKS-NG2 0/6 close verbatim instead of an unlocatable "highest-value surviving cycle" paraphrase; if a newer 2026-09-14/15 owner instruction exists only in chat, it is not evidence until it lands in a frozen artifact.

findings.question: Q3 SCIENCE (freeze ordering)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md §3: "3 chronological folds, preregistered boundaries at freeze; per-fold event population >= 60"; §6 orders D2 (measures "fold population" pre-score) BEFORE S ("selection freeze"). If "freeze" = S, boundaries would be fixed after D2 population numbers exist
findings.recommendation: Fix the ordering: the fold floor (>= 60) is frozen but the boundaries are not, and D2 needs boundaries to measure fold population. If boundaries are choosable after D2 counts are known, the >= 60 floor is boundary-shoppable in the resurrect-direction. Freeze the chronological fold boundaries in the P0 census commit (E6 manifest), before D2 runs. P-15/P-21 spirit: nothing is re-derived after numbers exist.

findings.question: Q5/registration preconditions (registry conventions)
findings.evidence: plans/CYCLE_REGISTRY.json rows: RATES-NG1 budget.used=0 vs phase "budget 3/6"; COMMODITIES-NG1 used=0 vs "3/6"; VOL-NG1 used=0 vs "6/6" (FOREX-NG1 correctly shows used=6; STOCKS-FREE-V13 used=3); STOCKS-NG1 and CRYPTO-NG1 rows carry stale phase "REGISTERED (planned)" under lifecycle TERMINAL; handbook §31 steps 1-2: reconcile terminal cycle + canonical registry before opening a new cycle; plan §10 step 4 registers via researchctl
findings.recommendation: Before or at STOCKS-NG3 registration, reconcile (via researchctl, never hand-edit) the budget.used counters for RATES-NG1/COMMODITIES-NG1/VOL-NG1 with their ledger-recorded consumption, or disclose the sync debt in the registration event. The ledger (P-9 authority) already carries the truth (program 248/251); the projection rows contradict it on budget.used. Run cycle doctor --json at intake.

findings.question: Q3 SCIENCE (E4 floor)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md §3 E4: timing coverage is "MEASURED and pinned" with a conservative fallback, but no minimum evidenced-timing-coverage floor is declared
findings.recommendation: Near-zero BMO/AMC coverage degrades the book to date-only conservative availability (still testable, conservative direction) with no prewritten kill. Either pin a minimum evidenced-timing-coverage floor with a declared BLOCKED consequence, or predeclare that any coverage level proceeds with the uniform fallback and the measured class split (evidenced vs fallback) disclosed as a stratification. FXFV3's availability-semantics correction flipped 19 positions — the program's own precedent for why this must be pinned.

findings.question: Q5 (terminal outcome set vs ng template)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md §8 lists 4 terminal outcomes; plans/PLAN_stocks_ng1.md §2 also preregistered STOCKS_NG1_BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH, absent in ng3
findings.recommendation: An A7 prelaunch REFUSED that cannot be remediated has no preregistered terminal label in ng3 (V10/V11/V15/V17 show refusal->remediation->re-audit is the normal path, so residual risk is low). Add STOCKS_NG3_BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH or predeclare that an unremediable prelaunch refusal closes under BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION.

findings.question: Q6 verification limits (NOT_RUN_EXECUTION_REQUIRED)
findings.evidence: Audited packet supplies HEAD 261b50a2 on main; this audit context has no execution tool, so git rev-parse verification of the plan-file SHA was not runnable; the audited content is the file at plans/PLAN_stocks_ng3.md as read

hunting_summary: Audited adversarially against registry, ledger, failure registry, lessons, MAP, ng templates, shadow plan §14 and handbook §14/§19/§31. VERIFIED TRUE: (1) FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl contains exactly 109 entries and grep for earnings/SUE/PEAD/EPS/surprise/post-earnings finds NO earnings family — the hits are filing-lag (SFV10-A4-H1), insider/10b5-1/amendment (SFV13, SFNG1, SFNG2), macro-release classes (FXFV5/V6/V7, FXNG1-A4-P2 CPI-surprise, CNG2 NFP, V17 funding jump) — so the earnings information set is genuinely unmeasured and the V8/V12 recorded reopening condition ('materially new information set') is satisfied by source, not re-parameterization. (2) NOT a rescue: SFV10-A4-H1 (timing-axis informative note), SFV13-A6-P1 dividend transition (mechanical REJECT, 'NOT rescuable'), 10b5-1/amendment closures and the momentum_63s shadow (V11 mandatory-lane killer at 0.219) are all explicitly disclaimed in §2 AND pinned into the C4 rho inventory at the 0.20 bar on the frozen decision-grid representation (P-12 honored — the FXFV9 representation lesson). (3) Controls C1-C6 map onto the program's known killers: C1 is the Q-7 / falsification-#16 clock class (RATES-NG1, COMMODITIES-NG1 both died to release-clock controls; external QuantPulse lineage already showed earnings 8-K clocks at 1.74x vs 2.53x credited — reinforcing the mandate), C2 exposure-form, C3 sham calendar, C4 includes day_of_week (FOREX-NG4's 0.89 geometry kill), C5 Q-11 valid-null, C6+E5 PIT. (4) P0 floors E1-E6 are concrete and fail-closed: E2 400 events/150 entities recent-window (Q-6), E3 2 dead canaries + 3/3 never-existed controls (canary method with two prior confirmed kills), E6 sha-pinned manifest; entitlement-gap precedent is exactly STOCKS-NG2's EODHD short-interest 404 -> CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, and the entitlement-holds precedent is the V8 six-gate probe 6/6 PASS with dead-name history — E1's 404->terminal BLOCKED at budget 0/6 is the cheap honest kill. (5) Registry: STOCKS-NG3 unused; conventions match the ng template (budget 6 max / 2 families = P-19's own words; GO phrase 'GO STOCKS NG3 SCORED EXECUTION' matches form; branch/worktree naming; REGISTERED_NOT_CONSUMED go state per PROSPECTIVE-SHADOW-V1; S1 SEALED_UNTOUCHED; two-key with A7 key STOCKS_NG3_S0_LAUNCH_AUTHORIZED then owner fresh GO, standing delegation explicitly excluded from GO — stricter than ng1's delegated GO, legal; no scored execution before its own gate; heavy lock; .env programmatic-only; registry writes only via researchctl). (6) Shadow non-interference: PROSPECTIVE-SHADOW-V1 §14 disclosure duty satisfied by §2 (different asset plane, no shared state, no reading shadow ledgers). (7) No manual registry edits, no S1, no orders, merge order lanes->integration with A1 sole integrator. No HIGH findings: nothing found that changes the scientific or legal conclusion of the plan as written.
verdict_rationale: The plan survives adversarial audit: the novelty claim's core is true against the frozen 109-entry registry, the hypothesis is falsifiable with prewritten failure interpretations and fail-closed numeric floors frozen in plan text, the data-authority kill design matches both repo precedents (V8 probe PASS / NG2 404 kill), all standing law (two-key P-8, budget 6/2-families per P-19, S1 seal, lock, credential, shadow non-interference, lanes/merge) is honored, and no rejected ancestor is being rescued — every named ancestor is disclaimed and measured again at D2. Four MEDIUM findings are accuracy/ordering/hygiene fixes (novelty wording, authority citation to P-19, fold-boundary freeze ordering, registry budget-used sync debt) that must be remediated or recorded before/at registration; none changes a conclusion, so the verdict is AUTHORIZED_WITH_FINDINGS rather than REFUSED.
